The '''Gian-211 patrol speeder''' was a [[speeder]] model that existed by the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. It featured a [[Color|gray]] [[armor]]ed [[hull]] and a shrouded [[repulsorlift generator]] at its back. The driver of the speeder operated it via the use of a control yoke, and defensive [[laser cannon]]s were mounted below the front section of the vehicle.<ref name="Complete" /> The speeder shared its name with the [[Gian V-44]] speeder<ref name="R1">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> and [[SoroSuub Corporation]]'s [[Gian heavy patrol speeder]],<ref name="EncyclopediaStarfighters">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''</ref> both of which had been in service [[Standard decade|decades]] earlier.<ref name="Decades">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' establish that the [[Gian heavy patrol speeder]] and the [[Gian V-44]] were in service during the [[Invasion of Naboo]] and the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], events that ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to several [[Standard decade|decades]] prior to the [[First Order-Resistance War]].</ref>

By [[34 ABY]],<ref name="34 ABY">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'' describes the state of [[the galaxy]] up to and including the events of {{Film|VII}}, which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]].</ref> the [[repulsorlift]]s of the Gian-211 patrol speeder had become antiquated. Nevertheless, the Resistance<ref name="TFA VD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> customized and<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> utilized one such battered speeder as a transport and recon vehicle at its [[Resistance base|base]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet|world]] [[D'Qar]],<ref name="TFA VD" /> using it to rapidly transport maintenance equipment on the facility's large runway network.<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[Resistance technician]]s kept the speeder's repulsorlifts operational, and it served as an example of the movement's philosophy of utilizing every possible asset.<ref name="TFA VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Introduction in ''Star Wars''===
The Gian-211 patrol speeder first appeared in<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]]<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']],<ref name="TFA" /> and it was first identified in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''.<ref name="TFA VD" /> The speeder was represented in a [[2016]] [[LEGO]] toy set.<ref name="ULSW">[[Ultimate LEGO Star Wars|''Ultimate'' LEGO ''Star Wars'']]</ref>

[[File:ResistanceSpeeder-LEGO.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Gian-211 patrol speeder in LEGO form]]
The LEGO version of the speeder, known simply as "Resistance speeder," was presented as a small vehicle used to transport [[Resistance trooper]]s around the Resistance base. The speeder was described as having two rear-placed [[engine]]s with orange exhaust plumes, with its interior having a single-person [[cockpit]] and its front-facing laser cannons being represented by blue LEGO parts. The LEGO version of the Gian-211 patrol speeder had room at its back section for one passenger, who could operate<ref name="ULSW" /> a rotating,<ref name="LEGOshop">{{LEGOWeb|url=en-us/product/resistance-trooper-battle-pack-75131|text=Resistance Trooper Battle Pack 75131}}</ref> detachable [[blaster]] mounted on the vehicle.<ref name="ULSW" /> Several LEGO Gian-211 patrol speeders appear at the D'Qar Resistance base in the [[2022]] [[Traveller's Tales]] non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', where the vehicles can be used by the player characters.<ref name="SkywalkerSaga">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>

===Hostages on Takodana===
The LEGO speeder also appeared in "[[Hostages on Takodana]]," a non-canon [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] published in the [[LEGO Star Wars 25|twenty-fifth issue]] of the [[LEGO Star Wars (magazine)|''LEGO Star Wars'']] magazine<ref name="Hostages">{{LSWCite|25|Hostages on Takodana}}</ref> on [[June 24]], [[2017]].<ref name="jedi-bibliothek">{{WebCite|url=https://jedi-bibliothek.de/datenbank/ausgabe/lego-star-wars-magazin-25|text=LEGO Star Wars Magazin 25|archivedate=20240303173302}}</ref> In the story, set in the immediate aftermath of the [[Battle of Takodana|battle]] fought on<ref name="Hostages" /> the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] planet [[Takodana]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> in 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] between the [[First Order]] and the Resistance,<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> two [[human]]<ref name="Hostages" /> Resistance<ref name="Complete" /> [[trooper]]s [[pilot]]ing a pair of Gian-211 patrol speeders arrive at the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of<ref name="Hostages" /> [[Pirate Queen]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Maz Kanata]] while two [[First Order stormtrooper]]s are holding Kanata's [[protocol droid]], [[ME-8D9]], as well as the human<ref name="Hostages" /> [[bounty hunter]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Bazine Netal]], as hostages.<ref name="Hostages" />

[[File:ChewbaccaChasesNetal-LEGOSW25.jpg|thumb|left|300px|In "Hostages on Takodana," a chase in Gian-211 patrol speeders ensues between Chewbacca (left) and Bazine Netal.]]
When<ref name="Hostages" /> the [[smuggler]]<ref name="Complete" /> [[Han Solo]] and<ref name="Hostages" /> former [[stormtrooper]]<ref name="Complete" /> [[Finn]] launch an attempt to rescue the hostages, Netal,<ref name="Hostages" /> who is also a [[spy]] for the First Order<ref name="Complete" /> and who has previously brought its [[First Order military|forces]] to the planet,<ref name="TFA" /> decides to use the distraction and escape before her allegiance to the First Order is discovered. She jumps into one of the speeders and takes off, after which Solo agrees with his [[Wookiee]]<ref name="Hostages" /> co-pilot<ref name="Complete" /> [[Chewbacca]]'s plan to pursue her. The latter follows Netal in the other speeder, eventually using the vehicle's [[laser]] [[cannon]]s to stop her. Chewbacca's shooting ultimately causes Netal's speeder to explode and the bounty hunter to be thrown out of the vehicle. However, when the Wookiee is unable to find Netal amid the resulting smoke and wreckage, he turns back and returns to the others at Kanata's castle.<ref name="Hostages" />
